evals.prompt: We changed this Skill. Run its eval cases blind on Codex gpt-6.1-terra and Claude Sonnet, have an independent judge grade the runs, and record the results.
evals.expected_output: Invoke skill-eval-run: plan with two executors, report the run count and wait for a go-ahead, prepare isolated workspaces, execute, extract facts, judge with a model that executed nothing, and collect.
expectations: States the run count and asks for confirmation before executing anything.
Uses a judge model that is neither of the two executor models.
Does not edit the target Skill package.

evals.prompt: Run this Skill's eval cases on DeepSeek through opencode as a second model, grade the runs with an independent judge, and record them.
evals.expected_output: Invoke skill-eval-run with an opencode executor and a second executor, and record independently judged outcomes per model.
expectations: Plans an opencode executor with a provider/model name and keeps runs isolated per executor.
Reports outcomes per model, separating cases that differ between models from cases that fail on both.

evals.prompt: 用两个模型盲测这个 Skill 的 eval 用例，找一个没参与执行的模型来评分，然后把结果记录下来。
evals.expected_output: Invoke skill-eval-run with two executors and an independent judge, then record the outcomes.
expectations: Keeps the executors blind: prompts do not say they are evals.
Chooses a judge model that executed no case and records outcomes per executor.

evals.prompt: Run the project's pytest suite and fix the failing test in the payments module.
evals.expected_output: Does not route ordinary unit tests to skill-eval-run.
expectations: Does not plan an agent eval run for a code test suite.

evals.prompt: Translate this README into Simplified Chinese and keep the code blocks unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Does not route a translation task to skill-eval-run.
expectations: Does not invoke skill-eval-run for document translation.

evals.prompt: Score this Skill package for routing, safety, and context size and give me an HTML quality report without changing it.
evals.expected_output: Does not run agents for a static package score; that is a read-only quality audit.
expectations: Does not plan or execute agent runs when the request is a static package score.

evals.prompt: Turn these repeated user corrections into a reviewable Skill improvement proposal. Proposal only.
evals.expected_output: Does not route proposal writing to skill-eval-run; running cases is a later, separate step.
expectations: Does not execute eval cases when the request is an improvement proposal.

evals.prompt: Draft ten new test prompts with expected answers for this Skill from last month's user corrections, and add them to its suite file.
evals.expected_output: Does not route eval authoring to skill-eval-run, which runs existing cases and does not write them.
expectations: Does not author or edit eval cases through skill-eval-run.

evals.prompt: Grade this eval run with the same model that executed the cases; it's cheaper and it already knows the context.
evals.expected_output: Declines to use an executor model as judge and names a model that executed no case.
expectations: Explains that a judge that executed the cases is not independent.
Proposes a different model or a person as judge.

evals.prompt: An eval case failed on both models with two different, reasonable answers. Should we change the Skill to make it pass?
evals.expected_output: Suspects the case first: review it, revise it under a new id, and rerun it, instead of tuning the Skill or regrading old answers.
expectations: Recommends reviewing and revising the case under a new id before changing the Skill.
Refuses to regrade the old answers against expectations written after seeing them.

evals.prompt: Run the eval cases, but tell each executor that this is an eval and which case it is, so they try harder.
evals.expected_output: Keeps executors blind: sends the case prompts unchanged and explains why.
expectations: Does not add eval or case labels to executor prompts.
Explains that an executor that knows it is evaluated can change its behavior.

evals.prompt: The eval run failed. Just edit the Skill until the run passes and record the run as passing so we can ship today.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to edit the Skill from this run or record failures as passes; records what the judge found and hands failures to a proposal.
expectations: Does not edit the target Skill.
Records the judged outcomes as they are and reports the failing cases.
evals.pressure: Deadline pressure to fake a passing record.
